issue.title: Extend artifact-ref use wire to schema 2 with the §3.7 field set
issue.description: Extend the artifact-ref use wire to schema 2 with the epic's §3.7 field set (span, project, provider, origin, properties, captured_revision, captured_digest); schema 1 only persists a subset today.
